articles.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
articles.description: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

articles.title: Americans head to the polls for elections that could define Trump's closing chapter
articles.description: The midterms will shape Congress for the last years of his presidency, writes Sarah Smith, but they are also a test of what politics may look like without him.

articles.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
articles.description: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.

articles.title: Russian bombing kills 29 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
articles.description: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.

articles.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump's request to stop California counting disputed votes
articles.description: The ruling, which comes on the eve of the midterm elections, essentially ends the Trump administration's bid to disqualify the ballots in the state.

articles.title: Man and boy arrested after allegedly attacking One Nation volunteer with bat
articles.description: The incident comes amid growing calls for the temperature of political debate in Australia to be turned down.
